name: @fleetos/desktop
description: FleetOS Desktop — the installable Ubuntu desktop app of the FleetOS product: the FleetOS shell (the F301 standalone build) over the composed durable deployment service at 127.0.0.1:3106.
author: FleetOS

scripts.dist: pnpm run build && pnpm run icon && pnpm run build:shell && pnpm run build:resources && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:deb: pnpm run build && pnpm run icon && pnpm run build:shell && pnpm run build:resources && electron-builder --linux deb
scripts.dist:appimage: pnpm run build && pnpm run icon && pnpm run build:shell && pnpm run build:resources && electron-builder --linux AppImage
